question: Should OpenClaw ship this phone-proxy-only Wear OS companion as a first-party Android form factor with shared signing and atomic phone/Wear Play publishing?
rationale: This introduces a new first-party application surface, release form factor, and authenticated operator-action projection; code review can assess implementation quality but cannot authorize that permanent product and support commitment.

options.title: Approve bounded Wear v1
options.body: Keep the phone as sole Gateway and credential owner, repair the integration blockers, obtain exact-head device proof, and land the full companion.

options.title: Stage status-only first
options.body: Narrow the first release to phone and Gateway status, deferring transcript, send, abort, notifications, voice, and TTS until a later reviewed stage.

options.title: Pause first-party Wear
options.body: Do not add the signed Wear form factor or release pipeline until Android ownership and support capacity are explicitly committed.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded Wear v1
recommendation.body: Keep the phone as sole Gateway and credential owner, repair the integration blockers, obtain exact-head device proof, and land the full companion.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the official product owner and sponsor of both the canonical issue and this consolidated implementation.
